summary: IDF intercepted two UAVs near the Jordan border while eliminating two senior terrorists in Gaza. Iran launched a large-scale UAV attack on Erbil and the Kurdistan Region, activating C-RAM defenses. Houthis claimed drone strikes on Saudi oil facilities, with Saudi Arabia intercepting drones originating from Iraqi airspace.
key_points: IDF intercepted two UAVs near Jordan border; aircraft did not enter Israeli airspace; launch source under investigation. (Source: @idf_telegram/24742)
IDF eliminated Nukhba terrorist Amr Abu al-Rish in southern Gaza and Hamas commander Abdel Nasser al-Aziz Maqadma in northern Gaza. (Source: @idf_telegram/24742)
Northern Brigade and Yahalom destroyed a Hamas underground tunnel route hundreds of meters long in northern Gaza. (Source: @inon_yttach/9693)
Iranian UAVs attacked Erbil, Koya, Soran, Kormor, and Khalifan in Kurdistan Region; jets and C-RAM systems intercepted. (Source: @shin_persian/8555)
Houthis claimed drone attacks on Saudi oil transfer centers en route to Yanbu; Saudi air defense intercepted drones from Iraqi airspace. (Source: @VahidOnline/77541)
Iranian Health Minister reported 60 killed and 670 injured in recent US strikes on southern Iran over 10-12 days. (Source: @SharghDaily/174798)
Triple US-Israel-Lebanon talks scheduled in Rome August 4-6 to discuss expanding Israeli redeployment in south Lebanon. (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/381399)
Netanyahu arrived in Washington; Trump warned of return to powerful military action if negotiations fail. (Source: @yediotnews25/133279)

sections.executive_summary: IDF intercepted two UAVs near the Jordan border while eliminating two senior terrorists in Gaza. Iran launched a large-scale UAV attack on Erbil and the Kurdistan Region, activating C-RAM defenses. Houthis claimed drone strikes on Saudi oil facilities, with Saudi Arabia intercepting drones originating from Iraqi airspace.

points: Three political prisoners — Alireza Sepahi, Abolfazl Sepahi, and Amirhossein Safari — were executed at Alikhani Square in Isfahan after the Supreme Court upheld death sentences; families were summoned for final farewells before executions carried out. (Source: @lelotsenzura/93949, @rodast_omiddana/77928, @rodast_omiddana/77936, @kianmeli1/90148, @mamlekate/104016)
Khatam al-Anbiya headquarters warned that necessary measures will be taken if the US continues a naval blockade and prevents Iranian maritime transit. (Source: @kianmeli1/90138)
Iranian Health Minister stated 60 citizens were killed and approximately 670 injured during 10-12 days of recent US strikes on southern Iran. (Source: @SharghDaily/174798)
Alternative roads have been paved around damaged bridges in Hormozgan Province shortly after US strikes. (Source: @presstv/200569)
Ukrainan President Zelensky accused Iran of supplying Shahed drones and manufacturing technology to Russia from the start of the Ukraine war. (Source: @mamlekate/104004)

IDF intercepted two UAVs identified in the Jordan border area; the aircraft did not cross into Israeli territory and no alerts were activated; launch source remains under investigation. (Source: @idf_telegram/24742, @idf_telegram/24734, @New_security8200/203006, @inon_yttach/9683, @Faytuks_Network/5797)

IDF eliminated Nukhba terrorist Amr Abu al-Rish in southern Gaza; he participated in the release of an Israeli hostage from PIJ captivity and was actively involved in fighting and terror planning against IDF forces. (Source: @idf_telegram/24742, @yediotnews25/133280)

IDF eliminated Hamas police commander and deputy platoon commander Abdel Nasser al-Aziz Maqadma in northern Gaza; he recently promoted terror plans against IDF and Israeli civilians. (Source: @idf_telegram/24742, @yediotnews25/133280)

Northern Brigade and Yahalom combat engineers destroyed a Hamas underground tunnel route spanning hundreds of meters in northern Gaza. (Source: @inon_yttach/9693, @New_security8200/203013, @manniefabian/58869)
Two Israeli civilians crossed the border into Syria near Mount Hermon; IDF located them and returned them to Israeli territory for questioning. (Source: @inon_yttach/9689)

Prime Minister Netanyahu flew to Washington; Trump stated he agreed to mediators' request to give negotiations a chance but will not wait long and will return to powerful military action if talks fail. (Source: @New_security8200/203008, @shin_persian/8567, @yediotnews25/133279)

Gantz insists on the number-one position in coalition negotiations, causing deadlock among Edelstein, Shaked, Smotrich, and Gantz; Ardan and Edelstein expected to announce decisions this week. (Source: @amitsegal/63429)

IDF forces in southern Gaza eliminated Nukhba terrorist Amr Abu al-Rish who took part in releasing an Israeli hostage from PIJ and was involved in ongoing combat and terror planning. (Source: @idf_telegram/24742)
IDF forces in northern Gaza eliminated Hamas police commander Abdel Nasser al-Aziz Maqadma who promoted terror plans against IDF and Israeli civilians. (Source: @idf_telegram/24742)
Northern Brigade and Yahalom destroyed a Hamas subterranean tunnel route hundreds of meters long in northern Gaza. (Source: @inon_yttach/9693, @New_security8200/203013, @manniefabian/58869)
Starting tomorrow, Palestinian workers will be permitted to return to communities in Judea and Samaria following a situational assessment. (Source: @N12chat/219504)
Four terrorists involved in kidnapping a soldier's weapon in Sussia over the weekend were arrested after intelligence efforts. (Source: @yediotnews25/133272)
Suspected security incident reported near the settlement of Eli. (Source: @lelotsenzura/93945)
Drone observed over Western Beqaa area including Zalaya, Midoun, Lucia, and Yahmar. (Source: @redlinkleb/33340)
Drone spotted opposite Shebaa heading toward Hasbaya. (Source: @redlinkleb/33312)

Researcher Hikmat Amhaz reported that Mojtaba Khamenei informed concerned parties in Lebanon and Iran there will be no negotiations with the US before the war in Lebanon ends, and no Iranian-US agreement before Israel withdraws and ceases flights and assassinations. (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/381393)
Triple talks between US, Israel, and Lebanon scheduled in Rome August 4-6 to discuss expanding Israeli redeployment in southern Lebanon. (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/381399)
Heavy artillery shelling with large-caliber rounds continuously targeting Nabatieh al-Fawqa. (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/381385)
Kurdish opposition headquarters attacked in Erbil, northern Iraq. (Source: @N12chat/219514)

Islamic Resistance in Iraq denied Saudi claims of carrying out a drone attack on the kingdom, warning any Saudi action against Iraq would draw a strong response. (Source: @presstv/200557, @presstv/200569)
US drone crashed in Anbar Province, Iraq. (Source: @presstv/200556)

Large-scale UAV attack on Erbil, Koya, Soran, Kormor, and Khalifan in the Kurdistan Region; UAVs reportedly launched from Iran; multiple jets intercepting; C-RAM systems active in Erbil. (Source: @shin_persian/8555, @shin_persian/8566)
Kurdish opposition headquarters in Sulaymaniyah, northern Iraq, targeted with a swarm of suicide drones in early morning hours. (Source: @naya_foriraq/85842)

Pakistani Foreign Ministry condemned drone attacks against Saudi Arabia originating from Iraq; Iraq joined the condemnation, stating it will not allow its territory to be used for attacks on neighboring countries. (Source: @yediotnews25/133286)
Documentation of the moment of targeting a separatist headquarters in Erbil Governorate, northern Iraq. (Source: @naya_foriraq/85826)

Houthi forces claimed drone attacks on Saudi crude oil transfer centers along the route from eastern Saudi Arabia to Yanbu port, citing response to Saudi drone airspace violations over Yemen. (Source: @VahidOnline/77541)
Saudi air defense intercepted several drones launched from Iraqi airspace by Iranian-backed armed groups targeting oil facilities in the eastern region and Riyadh. (Source: @VahidOnline/77541)

Saudi Ministry of Defense asserted its right to respond at a time and place of its choosing based on legitimate self-defense; Saudi Foreign Ministry demanded Iraq take all necessary measures to prevent use of its territory as a launchpad for attacks on Saudi Arabia. (Source: @VahidOnline/77541)

Tasnim news agency claimed the combined Houthi drone and missile strikes caused a fire at the Buqayq oil processing facility, one of the world's most important refining centers; Saudi officials have not confirmed a successful strike or fire at Buqayq. (Source: @VahidOnline/77541)
Islamic Resistance in Iraq denied Saudi accusations of drone attacks on the kingdom. (Source: @presstv/200557, @presstv/200569)
US official stated American sanctions and naval blockade will take longer to force Tehran to the negotiating table. (Source: @naya_foriraq/85840)

sections.threat_assessment: Multiple fronts are simultaneously active: Iranian UAVs striking the Kurdistan Region from Iranian territory, Houthi drones targeting Saudi energy infrastructure with Saudi intercepts over Iraqi airspace, and IDF conducting targeted killings and tunnel destruction in Gaza. The US strikes on southern Iran causing dozens of deaths and the Khatam al-Anbiya threat of retaliation against a naval blockade indicate a high risk of direct US-Iran escalation. The convergence of Iranian proxy activity in Iraq, Yemen, and Lebanon with Israeli operations in Gaza and the West Bank creates a volatile regional environment where miscalculation could trigger wider conflict.
sections.regional_response: Saudi Arabia has demanded Iraq prevent its territory from being used for attacks on the kingdom, while the Islamic Resistance in Iraq denies involvement and warns of strong response to any Saudi action. Pakistan and Iraq have jointly condemned the drone attacks on Saudi Arabia. Jordan's military intercepted drones targeting the kingdom. Lebanon is preparing for tripartite talks with the US and Israel in Rome to discuss Israeli redeployment in southern Lebanon, even as Mojtaba Khamenei reportedly conditions any US-Iran negotiations on an end to the war in Lebanon and Israeli withdrawal.
sections.intelligence_notes: The execution of three political prisoners in Isfahan signals intensified internal repression by Iranian authorities amid external pressure. The Khatam al-Anbiya statement suggests Iran is preparing asymmetric responses to a potential maritime blockade. The US drone crash in Anbar indicates ongoing surveillance operations over western Iraq. German arms exports to Israel have surged, including a nuclear-capable submarine, reflecting deepening Western military support. The documentation of Kurdish opposition headquarters strikes in both Erbil and Sulaymaniyah points to a coordinated campaign against Iranian-Kurdish groups.
